about.title: About me
paragraphs: I'm Sergio Tejon, a frontend developer from Bucaramanga, Colombia. I have a strong orientation towards excellence and collaborative work, and I focus on building robust solutions through meticulous attention to detail and constant process optimization.

I come from bilingual customer service, where I developed complex problem-solving, effective communication and pressure management skills. Today I apply those skills building interfaces with React, TypeScript and Next.js.
When I'm not coding, I'm usually exploring new technologies or improving personal projects like this portfolio.
